acceptance_checks.description: documents holds exactly 2000 documents for ns=demo, one per postgres documents row, with deterministic _id (uuid5 of the source key).
All 13876 document_versions rows are represented as a bounded per-document version subarray ordered by version number; no version row is lost and none is duplicated.
All 390 document_snapshots rows are migrated and reference their owning document by its migrated key; the 6 orphaned snapshots are reported rather than attached to a fabricated parent.
The 10 documents with non-contiguous version sequences are reported as version_gaps with the missing version numbers enumerated; gaps are never renumbered or backfilled.
documents carries a $jsonSchema validator requiring the tenant/ns field, a date-typed updated timestamp, and versions as an array of objects; a string date is rejected with server error 121.

Recon recomputes the manifest checksums e70001cf6110014dab6e1d80adb40285 (documents), 13bc033b2780a0569d7f2217e85d7303 (versions) and abe69084205723d6ad79e825b8c752dd (snapshots) from Atlas and matches all three exactly.
Re-running the migration for ns=demo reproduces identical counts, checksums, gap set, and orphan set.

encoding_policy.byte_transparency: Document bodies and titles are carried through byte-for-byte after decoding; no HTML/markdown rewriting, trimming, or Unicode normalization.
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: A value that cannot be decoded as UTF-8 is quarantined with reason invalid_encoding and its raw bytes recorded as hex; bytea content is preserved as BSON binary rather than lossily decoded.

malformed_record_policy.details: Unexpected extra fields in a source row are carried into an explicitly named extras subdocument and attributed in the recon report. A NULL owner, version number, or timestamp is never defaulted: the record is quarantined with a reason code.

empty_input_semantics.details: An empty source set leaves prior documents and snapshots untouched and exits zero.

planted_anomalies.description: 10 planted document version gaps in postgres.otterworks_demo.document_versions must be surfaced as an exact set of 10.
6 orphaned postgres.otterworks_demo.document_snapshots rows must be surfaced as an exact set of 6.
